title: The Yeast Sponge in the Warm Bowl
youtube_title: The Yeast Sponge in the Warm Bowl | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Leaving a cover on is a kind of trust.
summary: At a quiet craft corner with paper, paste, and a wooden rack, Una wants to check on a yeast sponge bubbling in a warm bowl before it is ready. With Auntie Luz nearby, Una leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
